import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "ppo_epochs": 2, "ent_coef": 0.005}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

TR = 32
D = 24
H = 16


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.Z = int(spec.Z)
        Z = self.Z
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        self.trunk_in = nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, TR, 1)
        self.t1 = nn.Conv2d(TR, TR, 3, padding=1)
        self.t2 = nn.Conv2d(TR, TR, 3, padding=1)
        self.ctx = nn.Conv2d(TR, D, 1)
        self.enc1 = nn.Conv2d(15 + Z, D, 1)
        self.enc2 = nn.Conv2d(D, D, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(2 * D, H, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(H, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * TR + 2 * D, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.register_buffer('zpos', torch.eye(Z))

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
        Z = self.Z
        t = F.relu(self.trunk_in(obs))
        t = F.relu(t + self.t1(t))
        t = F.relu(t + self.t2(t))
        layers = torch.stack([obs[:, 0:Z], obs[:, Z:2 * Z], obs[:, 2 * Z:3 * Z], obs[:, 3 * Z:4 * Z]], dim=2)
        below = F.pad(layers, (0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0))[:, :Z]
        above = F.pad(layers, (0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1))[:, 1:]
        gl = obs[:, 4 * Z:4 * Z + 3].unsqueeze(1).expand(B, Z, 3, Y, X)
        zp = self.zpos.view(1, Z, Z, 1, 1).expand(B, Z, Z, Y, X)
        raw = torch.cat([layers, below, above, gl, zp], dim=2).reshape(B * Z, 15 + Z, Y, X)
        ctx = self.ctx(t).unsqueeze(1).expand(B, Z, D, Y, X).reshape(B * Z, D, Y, X)
        u = F.relu(self.enc1(raw) + ctx)
        u = F.relu(u + self.enc2(u))
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn = u, u
            else:
                q = F.pad(u, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            s = out(F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn], dim=1))))
            s = s.reshape(B, Z, Y * X)
            res.append(torch.logsumexp(s, dim=1))
        place = torch.cat(res, dim=1)
        ul = u.reshape(B, Z, D, Y, X)
        g = torch.cat([t.mean((2, 3)), t.amax((2, 3)), ul.mean((1, 3, 4)), ul.amax((1, 3, 4))], dim=1)
        g = self.glob(g)
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 64, "rollout_len": 32, "n_minibatches": 16, "ppo_epochs": 1, "lr": 0.001, "ent_coef": 0.003, "gamma": 0.97, "gae_lambda": 0.95}

STEM = 64
W = 48
H = 16
G = 96


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.nt = int(spec.n_types)
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, W, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.hid = nn.Conv2d(W, self.nt * H, 3, padding=1)
        self.out = nn.Conv2d(self.nt * H, self.nt, 1, groups=self.nt)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * W, G), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(G, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(G, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        x = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(x + self.c1(x))
        x = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.out(F.relu(self.hid(x))).flatten(1)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([x.mean((2, 3)), x.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 64, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 8, "ppo_epochs": 3, "lr": 0.0007, "ent_coef": 0.003, "gamma": 0.97, "gae_lambda": 0.95}

COL = 64
K = 24
W = 32
H = 32


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        self.col = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, COL, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(COL, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.key = nn.Conv2d(COL, K, 1)
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(2 * K + W, H, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(H, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * W + 2 * K, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        h = self.col(obs)
        e = self.key(h)
        c = F.relu(self.c1(h))
        c = F.relu(c + self.c2(c))
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn = e, e
            else:
                q = F.pad(e, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            s = out(F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, c], dim=1))))
            res.append(s)
        place = torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)
        g = torch.cat([c.mean((2, 3)), c.amax((2, 3)), e.mean((2, 3)), e.amax((2, 3))], dim=1)
        g = self.glob(g)
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "ppo_epochs": 2, "ent_coef": 0.005}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32
FCC = 16


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        n_cells = int(spec.Y) * int(spec.X)
        self.fc_proj = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, FCC, 1)
        self.fc = nn.Linear(FCC * n_cells, int(spec.n_actions))
        nn.init.normal_(self.fc.weight, std=0.01)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.fc.bias)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        conv_logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        fl = F.relu(self.fc_proj(f)).flatten(1)
        logits = conv_logits + self.fc(fl)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

        fl = F.relu(self.fc_proj(f)).flatten(1)
        logits = self.fc(fl)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 64, "rollout_len": 32, "n_minibatches": 16, "ppo_epochs": 1, "lr": 0.002, "ent_coef": 0.003, "gamma": 0.97, "gae_lambda": 0.95}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32
FCC = 16


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        n_cells = int(spec.Y) * int(spec.X)
        self.fc_proj = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, FCC, 1)
        self.fc = nn.Linear(FCC * n_cells, int(spec.n_actions))
        nn.init.normal_(self.fc.weight, std=0.01)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.fc.bias)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        conv_logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        fl = F.relu(self.fc_proj(f)).flatten(1)
        logits = conv_logits + self.fc(fl)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "ppo_epochs": 2, "ent_coef": 0.005, "gamma": 0.97, "gae_lambda": 0.95}

CX = 32
D = 32
H = 16


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.Z = int(spec.Z)
        Z = self.Z
        C = int(spec.in_channels)
        Y = int(spec.Y)
        X = int(spec.X)
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        ys = torch.linspace(-1.0, 1.0, Y).view(1, 1, Y, 1).expand(1, 1, Y, X)
        xs = torch.linspace(-1.0, 1.0, X).view(1, 1, 1, X).expand(1, 1, Y, X)
        self.register_buffer('coords', torch.cat([ys, xs], 1).contiguous())
        self.register_buffer('zpos', torch.eye(Z))
        self.ctx_in = nn.Conv2d(C + 2, CX, 1)
        self.ctx1 = nn.Conv2d(CX, CX, 3, padding=1)
        self.ctx2 = nn.Conv2d(CX, CX, 3, padding=1)
        self.l1 = nn.Conv2d(C, D, 1)
        self.l1c = nn.Conv2d(CX, D, 1)
        self.zl = nn.Linear(Z, D)
        self.l2 = nn.Conv2d(D, D, 1)
        self.l3 = nn.Conv2d(D, D, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(2 * D, H, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(H, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * CX + 2 * D, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64 + 2, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
        Z = self.Z
        co = self.coords.expand(B, 2, Y, X)
        t = F.relu(self.ctx_in(torch.cat([obs, co], dim=1)))
        t = F.relu(t + self.ctx1(t))
        t = F.relu(t + self.ctx2(t))
        base = self.l1(obs) + self.l1c(t)
        ze = self.zl(self.zpos).view(1, Z, D, 1, 1)
        u = F.relu(base.unsqueeze(1) + ze).reshape(B * Z, D, Y, X)
        u = F.relu(u + self.l2(u))
        u = F.relu(u + self.l3(u))
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn = u, u
            else:
                q = F.pad(u, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            s = out(F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn], dim=1))))
            s = s.reshape(B, Z, Y * X)
            res.append(torch.logsumexp(s, dim=1))
        place = torch.cat(res, dim=1)
        ul = u.reshape(B, Z, D, Y, X)
        g = torch.cat([t.mean((2, 3)), t.amax((2, 3)), ul.mean((1, 3, 4)), ul.amax((1, 3, 4))], dim=1)
        g = self.glob(g)
        pm = place.detach()
        dfeat = torch.cat([pm.amax(1, keepdim=True), pm.mean(1, keepdim=True)], dim=1)
        done = self.done_head(torch.cat([g, dfeat], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, done], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 64, "rollout_len": 32, "n_minibatches": 16, "ppo_epochs": 1, "lr": 0.0007, "ent_coef": 0.003, "gamma": 0.97, "gae_lambda": 0.95}

DM = 64
HEADS = 4
FF = 128
PROJ = 24
HID = 24


class Block(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.n1 = nn.LayerNorm(DM)
        self.att = nn.MultiheadAttention(DM, HEADS, batch_first=True)
        self.n2 = nn.LayerNorm(DM)
        self.ff = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(DM, FF), nn.ReLU(), nn.Linear(FF, DM))

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.n1(x)
        a = self.att(h, h, h, need_weights=False)[0]
        x = x + a
        x = x + self.ff(self.n2(x))
        return x


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        n_cells = int(spec.Y) * int(spec.X)
        self.embed = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(int(spec.in_channels), DM), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(DM, DM))
        self.pos = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, n_cells, DM) * 0.02)
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList([Block(), Block()])
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(DM)
        self.head = PoolHead(DM, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * DM, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64 + 2, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
        tok = obs.flatten(2).transpose(1, 2)
        x = self.embed(tok) + self.pos
        for blk in self.blocks:
            x = blk(x)
        x = F.relu(self.norm(x))
        f = x.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, DM, Y, X)
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([x.mean(1), x.amax(1)], dim=1))
        pm = place.detach()
        dfeat = torch.cat([pm.amax(1, keepdim=True), pm.mean(1, keepdim=True)], dim=1)
        done = self.done_head(torch.cat([g, dfeat], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, done], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

analyses.1: There are no trials yet. The starting network scored 0.000 on both seeds, which is a complete failure rather than seed noise. Two causes seem likely. (1) Too few policy updates: the default recipe gives only 32 PPO updates (131k steps / 4096 per update). (2) A perception gap: a placement is right only if the target is missing every footprint cell at the landing layer, which is the highest build height under the footprint. The starting net collapses the layers into 2D features early, so it has to learn this match between landing height and layer indirectly. The three trials form a 2x2 design (the starting network on the default recipe is the fourth cell): a recipe-only change (fewer epochs, more and smaller updates), a layer-aware head that pools over footprints in each layer, and both together.
analyses.2: Every trial so far scores 0 on dev and 0 on training success. That includes the baseline, the per-layer head, and both of those with a 2-epoch recipe that gave about 240k samples. All results are flat, so the trials do not rank anything, and seed noise is not the issue. Training never reaches an exact build, so nothing so far gets the policy off the ground within the budget. The world may also differ from its description, for example in how anchors map to cells or how bricks drop. In that case a head hard-wired to top-left footprint pooling could be misaligned. This round makes three different bets: (A) the baseline network with a 1-epoch recipe for the most samples (about 426k), longer credit assignment and lower entropy; (B) a head that makes no assumption about footprint geometry, with the same recipe; (C) a deeper per-column encoder pooled over footprints, with a 3-epoch, small-batch recipe for many gradient steps.
analyses.3: All six trials scored exactly 0 on dev, and also 0 on training success in the last 10% of training. That held across four very different heads (footprint pooling, per-layer pooling, a 3x3 conv per type, column keys) and recipes from 1 to 4 epochs and 131k to 407k samples. Seed noise cannot explain a uniform 0, so something systematic is blocking learning. The task warns that this world may not match its description. One suspect fits: every head so far assumes the stated mapping from action index to anchor cell, and each puts a type's logit map in place spatially. If the real layout is permuted (type-minor order, transposed axes, or footprints listed in a different order), none of these heads can express the right policy. A head that reads the flattened features with a fully connected layer works under any layout. This round tests that idea; an all-zero result again would point at the training budget instead.
analyses.4: Nine trials and 18 seeds have all scored exactly 0, both on dev and in training success. None of these changes helped: more updates, more samples, longer credit assignment (gamma/lambda), a 3x3 head that ignores footprint layout, or flat fully connected heads that can learn any action layout. So a different action layout and a shortage of samples are unlikely to be the only problems. Two explanations remain. (1) Precision: the dense reward pays for sloppy placements, such as a 2x2 brick covering 3 target cells and 1 extra. So the agent fills the target with permanent extra cells and never finds the +1 exact-build bonus. That requires features that check, for each column and layer, whether a placement is exact. (2) A DONE trap: early random DONE presses end episodes with nothing gained, so DONE is pushed down. DONE also only sees pooled global features, so it cannot tell when no good placement is left. This last round tests a DONE head that also sees the placement logits, both alone and combined with richer perception.
